Nina P.: hey team, nina from infra — starting oncall next week and getting a bit lost on who to ping for runbook access + shadow slots. I hit a 403 on /runbooks/index.md. :wave:

Eli G.: welcome! file the access request at https://wiki.internal/access-requests -> 'oncall-runbooks' and paste the ticket id here. We usually do 2x 90m shadows then one supervised solo.

Nina P.: request submitted: PRR-5037. Also my PagerDuty shows 'not eligible'.

OpsBot: Access request PRR-5037 received. Okta sync queued.

Harper J.: tagged infra-admins. Nina, I can be your shadow — free Tue 14:00-15:30 UTC and Thu 09:00-10:30 UTC. I'll also invite you to the shadow calendar event.

Eli G.: Okta sync completed, added Nina to group 'infra-oncall'. You should get a PD test shortly. Quick PD test command: `pd trigger --user "nina.p@redwood.com" --note "oncall test"`. If you don't see push within 60s, ping me.

OpsBot: User "Nina P." added to group "infra-oncall" (audit id: a12f). Checklist assigned: read incident-lifecycle.md, run PD test, attend 2 shadows. Due in 3 days.

Nina P.: got the PD push and the runbook email. Thanks Eli + Harper — I accepted the invite for Tue. One question: can I open runbook PRs during probation for small clarifications?

Harper J.: yes, open PRs are fine. We require owner + SRE reviewer on probation changes. Small copy fixes usually merge fast. See CONTRIBUTING.md in runbooks.

Nina P.: perfect, thanks all!
